decision: Keep existing nonlinear autoencoder qualification separate; add a certifiable convex per-repository adapter where a convergence guarantee is required.
fixed_inputs: Pinned repository snapshot and typed AST/symbol graph
Source/model/profile/dependency scoped compiler-backed targets from proof index
Versioned normalization and family projections; unsupported fragments remain opaque
trainable_scope: Regularized linear adapter/readout over fixed features or fixed embeddings; independently trained nonlinear encoder is frozen during a certified adapter run.
objective: Mean squared typed-target reconstruction or pair-logistic relevance plus positive L2 regularization.
certificates_required: Exact feature and target hashes; target provenance distinguishes source-derived and conditional models
Positive regularization; exact or interval Hessian upper bound
A descent/contraction theorem applicable to chosen objective/update rule
Binary64 update error bounds or an exact-rational reference optimizer
Finite run stopping criterion with authenticated intermediate weight states
Heldout source/program contract reconstruction and task outcomes
what_this_cannot_certify: Global convergence of simultaneously changing tanh encoder/decoder/Adam/clipped updates
Semantic correctness merely because a loss decreases
Full codebase semantics for opaque unsupported fragments
Natural language intent alignment without reviewed source grounding
integration: Repository-specific adapter/checkpoint IDs join DuckDB/DuckLake source/AST/KG/vector/contract/proof dependencies; symbolic planner consumes only proofs matching current snapshot, assumptions and toolchain.
